beats.speaker: narrator

beats.speaker: quill

beats.speaker: vane

beats.speaker: vane

beats.speaker: hearth

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: I don't tour. I root.

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.speaker: odessa

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: Walls stay shut.

beats.speaker: odessa

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.line: Two slow things. One burns. One sinks and keeps going.

beats.line: Name gone. Forward heat.

beats.line: The river learns my weight. Heat is optional.

beats.speaker: anvil

beats.line: Fog is the payroll.

beats.line: Wounds report. Fog collects.

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Plural dies cheap. Wheels come back.

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.speaker: commando

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Don't dress it so loud the trespassers hear the punchline.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: They hear the punchline when they step wrong. You just keep the lights honest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Pad tooth. Dirty tooth. Same radius — finally useful to each other.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: After a Drop where the ring held and the mines wrote the footnotes.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: Your Ferrets waited. My Trappers didn't have to introduce themselves twice.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: I don't chase. You don't announce. That worked.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: …Keep them inside. Outside the circle is someone else's comedy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Support thickens. Trespassers will not enjoy the collaboration.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: One refuses to tour. One refuses to cool. The pad feels both.

beats.line: Quiet sun. Won't go out.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: Name gone. Forward heat.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.line: Then eat from me, not from the wiring. Hunger that chews the grid kills the lights.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: …Feed the roast. Walls after.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Supply meets hunger. Neither calls it friendship. The company does.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Mud that stays. Lightning that won't.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: The river learns my weight.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Sight is a wound you give them. I draw the ford before you sit on it.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: Draw quiet. I arrive loud enough.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Quiet's optional. Accurate isn't. Stay heavy — I'll keep the map bleeding where it should.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Spot meets siege. The ford gets a rumor, then a Turtle.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Something already walked the lane. Something else is about to occupy it.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Ghosts already walked it.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: Then I'll sit where they finished. Ghosts don't hold fords.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: They hold rumors. I end careers. You end geography.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: Whisper the hinge. I'll be the door.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Snipe and plod — a cruel, complete sentence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A plasma house that learned to walk. A Jaguar that learned to listen for footsteps.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: House learned to knock.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Sight is a wound you give them. Your knock is a wound you give *me* if I'm still on the porch.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Then leave the porch. I don't aim for friends. Friends aim for elsewhere.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Teach me the cadence. I'll burn the map — just not while you're rewriting it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: First lesson: when the house knocks, the eyes are already gone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: After a Drop where Volt's pack ghosted the splash before it landed.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Three knocks. I counted. We weren't there for the fourth.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Good. Porch stays empty when the door learns manners.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Bro's Tzar shrugs the same rhythm. Different house. Same homework.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Learn both cadences. I don't share a contract with regret.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Support becomes timing. Timing becomes not dying to friends.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A shrug with a Tzar. A whisper with a career-ending hobby.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Yeah. I'll take that wall.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Ghosts already walked it. Try not to take the ghosts too.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: I don't aim personal. Walls are impersonal.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Then I'll be elsewhere when you get casual. Whistle once if the shrug is loading.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: She starts learning the whistle. He pretends he doesn't notice. He notices.

beats.line: One pays for weather. One invoices the unknown.

beats.speaker: veil
beats.line: Ghosts are free. Trespassers aren't. Point the circle — I'll own the dark around it.

beats.line: Unpaid wars. Careers that end quietly.

beats.line: Three wars unpaid.

beats.line: I shoot wages. You shoot rumors.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Wheels don't do poetry. They do early.

beats.line: Tithe gets a scout. Scout gets a reason to come home.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A bay that dreams upward. A garden that refuses to leave.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: Dreams in flight paths.

beats.line: Then dream useful. Roots need a map before they spend light.

beats.line: Eyes first. Your constructors can argue with dirt after.

beats.line: A saint of surplus. A pronoun with a factory.

beats.line: Tithe the grid.

talks.title: Silhouette
talks.motif: the gunship and the saint who shoots gunships

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Archangel's barrels track the Roughneck all the way in to land. Nobody asked them to.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: You can stop aiming at me. I'm parked.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Everything with rotors is a prayer I haven't answered yet.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Altitude is an opinion, saint.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Then keep yours low over my pad.

talks.title: Learning the shape
talks.motif: the gunship and the saint who shoots gunships

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Kettle has chalked a Roughneck's outline on the Archangel's hull. Crossed through, then uncrossed.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Is that me?

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: It's the shape I don't shoot. I keep practising not shooting it.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Romantic.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: It's harder than shooting. Fly where I can see you and it gets easier.

talks.title: Under the roof
talks.motif: the gunship and the saint who shoots gunships

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: After the drop, the Roughneck sat out the enemy flak inside Kettle's umbrella for a whole minute.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Their fighters peeled off when they saw who was under me.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: They saw a chainsaw with wings over a gunship. Nobody argues with that.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: So the sky's ours.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: The sky is nobody's. The little bit over you is mine.

talks.title: The bill

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Nox will not sit where Ceil's shadow falls.

beats.speaker: nox
beats.line: Still paying for the last sky.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: I flew that sortie. I know what it cost.

beats.speaker: nox
beats.line: You know what it cost you. I hold the rest of the invoice.

talks.title: Instalments
talks.motif: the debt of the last sky

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Ceil has started landing beside the Umbrella and saying nothing, which is the most Ceil has ever said.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Tell me what's still owed.

beats.speaker: nox
beats.line: Forty-one names and a launch I didn't stop.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Then I'll fly cover over every launch you're near. Count it as an instalment.

beats.speaker: nox
beats.line: Debt doesn't take instalments. It takes years.

talks.title: Paid in sky
talks.motif: the debt of the last sky

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The missile came in high. The Umbrella took it. The Roughneck had already cleared the bombers that would have followed.

beats.speaker: nox
beats.line: That was the shape of the last sky. Except we won it.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Is the bill smaller?

beats.speaker: nox
beats.line: It's still there. It's just not mine alone anymore.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Fatboy's crew watches the sky the way people watch weather.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: House learned to knock. Never learned to duck.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Bombers love a slow house.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Then be the roof.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Archangel now parks a little behind the Fatboy, always on the bombers' side.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Your shells are loud. They bring company.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Company's why I knock.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Then I'll keep answering the door upstairs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Three bombing runs, three burning wrecks, one Fatboy still knocking.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Didn't look up once.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: That's the point of a roof.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: House has a roof now. Feels like a home.

talks.title: Whose sky
talks.motif: who owns the sky over the pad

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Warder has drawn the pad's circle in the dirt again. Kettle has driven through it again.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Owns a circle of dirt. And the air above it.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: The air goes where the fight goes. So do I.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Then the pad is naked every time you wander.

talks.title: Shifts
talks.motif: who owns the sky over the pad

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They have started taking the sky in shifts, and arguing about the handover.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Your ferrets cover the pad. I cover the march.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: My ferrets don't chase. They stay.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: That's why I trust them with what I leave behind.

talks.title: Two roofs
talks.motif: who owns the sky over the pad

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A bomber wing came for the pad while the Archangel was out on the line. It never reached the circle.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Told you the dirt holds.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: You did. I came back because I wanted to see it hold.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Go wander. The circle will be here.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Two of Noctua's drones came home with Archangel burns.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: Dreams in flight paths. Yours went through mine.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Mine go where the enemy is. Yours were in the way.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: Then teach them where the way is.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Kettle has painted the drone lanes on Noctua's bay wall: where the flak goes, and where it never goes.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Fly the cold lanes. I'll keep them cold.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: They're learning. They hum when they pass you now.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: That's the right sound.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Twenty-four drones and an Archangel fought one sky together and did not touch once.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: They fly around your fire like it's weather.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: It is weather. You taught them to read it.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: You taught me first.

talks.title: From up there

beats.line: Mira wants to know what napalm looks like from altitude.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.line: Napalm is confetti. Tell me it's prettier from up there.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: It's a map. You colour it in.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.line: Then call me the colours.

talks.title: Spotting
talks.motif: spot meets siege, from the sky

beats.speaker: ceil

beats.speaker: mira
beats.line: You're the best spotter I've ever had. You never ask me to stop.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: I'm a gunship. I don't know the word.

talks.title: Fireworks
talks.motif: spot meets siege, from the sky

beats.line: The barrage walked exactly where the Roughneck's tracers pointed, and then a little further for joy.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.line: Did you see it?

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: From up here it looked like a festival.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.line: It was. You were the guest of honour.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Volt and Ceil keep score on the same board. Neither agreed to it.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Sight is a wound you give them. I gave seven today.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Six of those were already burning when I flew off them.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Burning is not dead.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Both came back with redlined engines and nothing left in the tank.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: You fly like me.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: You drive like me. With rotors.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: One of us should learn to stop.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Not today.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The board says fourteen. It doesn't say whose.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: I stopped counting which were mine.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Me too. Turns out it's faster when you don't.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Don't tell anyone we're friends.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Commando's Hercules pilot and Ceil came up in the same hangar. It shows.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: Mines before the argument.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: You mined the hangar door once. Before the argument.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: You started the argument.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Hercules dropped Commando's crew behind a line the Roughneck had just emptied.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: You were late.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: You were early. That's the same as being late, but louder.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Like old times.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Mines, a drop, a gunship pass. Nobody on the other side ever saw the whole of it.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: We should do this for money.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: We do.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: Then we should do it for fun. It's better for fun.

talks.title: Off the beat

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Vane's Phobos had the line peeled and ready. Then the Roughneck took it.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: Pack is one thought. You're a second one.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: It was a free kill.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: Nothing in my rhythm is free. You broke it.

talks.title: Counting in
talks.motif: rhythm and the thing that breaks it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Ceil has started waiting for the pack's beat before diving. Most of the time.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: I'm counting your rhythm now. Three, then the peel, then me.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: Four. You come in on four.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Four, then.

talks.title: In time
talks.motif: rhythm and the thing that breaks it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The pack peeled, the Roughneck came in on four, and the line folded like a door.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: That was one thought.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: With rotors.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: Don't spoil it.

talks.title: Ghosts and drones
talks.motif: the sniper and the eyes that fly

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Yeva lies in the grass. A drone hums overhead and does not give her away.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Ghosts already walked it.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: Drones already flew it. Your ghosts were where I said.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Then we agree.

talks.title: Spotting
talks.motif: the sniper and the eyes that fly

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Noctua's drones mark, Yeva's rifle answers. It has become a conversation.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: Two hundred metres, behind the wall, the one with the antenna.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: I see the antenna. I'll leave the wall standing. It's pretty.

talks.title: Quiet sky
talks.motif: the sniper and the eyes that fly

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A whole enemy relay went silent and nobody on their side heard a shot.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Your drones are the only noise I like.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: Your rifle is the only quiet I trust.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Twenty fleas and twenty-four drones reported the same ridge in the same second.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: We saw it first.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: From the ground. I saw it from the sky.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: We speak in plurals. Plurals win.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They have divided the map: ground to Tick, sky to Noctua. The border is disputed.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: The ridge line is mine. It's high.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: The ridge is dirt. Dirt is ours.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: Then we both watch it. Twice the eyes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Nothing moved on the map that the company did not see from two directions.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: We counted you in our plurals.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: I'll put you in a flight path. It's the nicest thing I know.

talks.title: What she was built for
talks.motif: the bomber the saint was built to stop

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Kettle has a Hailstorm silhouette chalked inside the Archangel's hatch. It predates Thresh.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Weather comes from above.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: And I come from below. That's what they built me for. You.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Then we'll get on. Nobody else takes me seriously.

talks.title: Practice runs
talks.motif: the bomber the saint was built to stop

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Thresh flies dummy runs over the camp. Kettle tracks every one and fires at none.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Third pass. I had you on all three.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: I know. I wanted to know what it feels like to be had.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: And?

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Honest. Nobody's ever been honest with me at that altitude.

talks.title: The only sky I trust
talks.motif: the bomber the saint was built to stop

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Enemy anti-air lit up the whole valley. The Hailstorm flew home through the one corridor Kettle had cleared.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: You made me a road.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: If anyone shoots you down, it'll be me. I'm not sharing.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: That's the kindest threat I've ever had.

talks.title: Two kinds of knocking
talks.motif: the house knocks, the sky knocks

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Fatboy and Thresh compare craters like other people compare scars.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: House learned to knock.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Sky learned to knock louder.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Louder isn't deeper.

talks.title: The same wall
talks.motif: the house knocks, the sky knocks

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They hit the same wall on the same sortie. Neither will say who finished it.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Your shells softened it.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Your bombs took the credit.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: The wall didn't mind.

talks.title: Weather and house
talks.motif: the house knocks, the sky knocks

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: One plodding house, one bomber, and an enemy citadel that stopped being a citadel.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Never looked up.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Never looked down. I think that makes us family.

talks.title: Floating
talks.motif: the ford and the wing over it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Six Cutlasses sit on the river like a flock of ducks. Anvil's Turtles wade past them.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: The river learns my weight.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: The river doesn't notice mine. That's the trick.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: Then we're both cheating.

talks.title: Flood season
talks.motif: the ford and the wing over it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: When the waterline rose over Koom, the two of them were the only ones smiling.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Everyone else sees a flood. I see a runway.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: I see a floor.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Same water. Better company.

talks.title: Amphibious
talks.motif: the ford and the wing over it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Turtles took the ford while the Cutlasses held the sky over it. The enemy had planned for a dry bed.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: Weight first.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Wings second. Poetry never.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Ceil parks on the pad. Gale parks on the pond next to it.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Altitude is an opinion.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: So is the ground. I never land on it.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Show-off.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Roughnecks high, Cutlasses low. They don't call it a formation. It is one.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: You take the ridges, I take the river.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: And whoever finishes first takes the rest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Eleven gunships over one valley, none of them in the other's way.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Didn't think I'd share a sky.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: You didn't. We built a bigger one.

talks.title: Left of whom
talks.motif: the spare king and the left hand

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Mask's Pawns salute him. Pavise watches and says nothing for a long time.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: I still walk your left. The real one's.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: Every throne needs a spare.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: The spare doesn't get a salute.

talks.title: Drawing fire
talks.motif: the spare king and the left hand

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The enemy spent half its artillery on Mask. Pavise noticed who that saved.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: They think I'm you. Or you're me. I lose track.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: You drew fire meant for the company.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: It's what I was built for. I'm just doing it on purpose now.

talks.title: Two crowns
talks.motif: the spare king and the left hand

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Pavise has started walking on Mask's left, too, when the Pawns can see.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: You don't have to.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: I walk the left of whoever they're aiming at. Today it's you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Auditor has a column for every unit the company owns. Rumor keeps adding rows.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Ledger with legs. Where did these four tanks come from?

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: Everything changes sides eventually.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Not in my books it doesn't. Not without a receipt.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Rumor now leaves a scrap of paper on every captured unit. It says 'paid'.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: That isn't a receipt.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: It is to them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The books balanced this sortie, for the first time since Rumor arrived.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: You captured exactly what we lost.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: I read your ledger. I hate leaving you a deficit.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Veil's jammers hide everything. Rumor seems to be inside the fog before it rolls in.

beats.speaker: veil
beats.line: Fog is the payroll.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: Then I'm paid in advance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Ghosts walk into the enemy base inside Veil's blind spot, and walk out with a factory.

beats.speaker: veil
beats.line: They never saw you.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: They never saw you. I was just standing in it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: An entire enemy patrol changed sides without a shot, and nobody on either team can say how.

beats.speaker: veil
beats.line: The perfect contract.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: The perfect rumor.

talks.title: Counting
talks.motif: the one who counts the living and the one who counts the dead

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: After every drop, Pavise counts heads. Ketha counts wrecks. They finish at the same moment.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: Eleven walked back.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Two didn't. I have their names.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: Then between us we have all of them.

talks.title: The left and the back
talks.motif: the one who counts the living and the one who counts the dead

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Pavise walks on the commander's left. Ketha walks behind everyone.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: You keep them from falling.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: You pick them up when I fail.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: You don't fail often. I notice when you do. I never tell them.

talks.title: Twenty years
talks.motif: the one who counts the living and the one who counts the dead

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Two cups of tea, gone cold. Neither of them drinks it. That is not the point.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: Twenty years with the Armada and I never had someone to hand the ones I lost to.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Now you do. I'll carry them. You keep walking left.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Solarium has a spreadsheet. Consul has built three walls that are not on it.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: Spreadsheets, then sunlight. In that order.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: I build when it feels owed.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: Feelings are not a budget line.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Solarium found a column called 'Consul: apologies'. It balances to the metal.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: You started tracking me.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: You were going to build them anyway. I'd rather know what they cost.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: Every one of them costs more than metal.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The pad went up in half the time. Solarium planned it; Consul built it as if someone's life depended on it. Someone's did.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: You were under budget.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: First time in years something I built didn't feel like penance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Twitcher welded a mine into Cinder Hook's bunk. Cinder Hook mined Twitcher's workbench. Both are delighted.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: Grins with a welder.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: Mines before the argument.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: We never have the argument.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They have started sharing a workbench, which the rest of the camp regards as a strategic threat.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: Your welds hold. My mines go off. Think of the children.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: What children.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: Exactly.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The enemy's supply road stopped existing. Nobody saw it happen. Two Cortex deserters were laughing in a ditch.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: We should charge for this.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: We do. They just don't know where to send the bill.

talks.title: Volume
talks.motif: who is loudest at handshake range

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Cauter's riot cannon and Kit's Belchers went off at the same wall. Nobody could hear for an hour.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: Riot as punctuation.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: Fireworks as a sentence. Mine was longer.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: Mine ended it.

talks.title: The scoreboard
talks.motif: who is loudest at handshake range

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They have a chalkboard. It has two columns: 'loud' and 'louder'. They keep switching which one is theirs.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: You were louder today. I'm furious.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: You set fire to the chalkboard.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: That's a point.

talks.title: Duet
talks.motif: who is loudest at handshake range

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They hit the line together. Riot first, then fire, then nothing standing.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: That was the loudest thing I've ever heard.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: We should do it again. Louder.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Halq calls grid references. Verse counts missiles. From a distance it sounds like a hymn.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Four-seven, two-nine.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: Six, five, four...

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: You're counting my rockets.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: I count everything. Yours land where you say.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They have started finishing each other's numbers.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: Three missiles left.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Three targets on the map.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: I never reach zero without something dying.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Then let's make the math come out even.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Verse reached zero. Halq's map was empty. Neither of them said a word for a long time.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: That's the first time the grid had nothing left on it.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: I counted it with you. It sounded better in two voices.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Auditor sits down next to Grath at the fire. Grath does not move. Nobody else breathes.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Ledger with legs. Three wars, Grath.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.line: Arrears. Not unpaid. Arrears.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: The difference is interest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Auditor walked beside Grath's Karkinos all sortie, and wrote down every enemy he held back.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.line: Counting my debts again?

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Counting your payments. You've been making them for years. Nobody wrote them down.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Auditor tore a page out of its ledger and handed it to Grath.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.line: What's this?

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Receipt. Three wars. Paid in full, by holding the middle.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.line: ...I don't know how to stand without the weight.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Then hold the middle for free. It looks the same from outside.

talks.title: Expenditure
talks.motif: counting out loud against counting the cost

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Verse counts missiles out loud. The Auditor counts their price, also out loud.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: Five, four, three.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: One thousand two hundred, two thousand four hundred...

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: You're ruining it.

talks.title: Value
talks.motif: counting out loud against counting the cost

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Every missile is a word, you said. Do you know what your words cost?

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: Do you know what silence costs? I counted it once. It cost us Rusk's gate.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: ...I'll add that to the column.

talks.title: Worth it
talks.motif: counting out loud against counting the cost

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Auditor has stopped reading the price aloud. It just writes 'worth it' beside each of Verse's volleys.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: You stopped counting.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: I started trusting the count you do.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Spoke trusts nothing that walks. Stride does not walk.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Only trusts wheels.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: We don't count shots. We count exits.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Show me the exits, then.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A Wheelie and a Saloon raced the whole map and both claim they won.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: Your bots are fast.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Your manners are faster. You insulted the referee.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: There was no referee.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Not after you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: When the pad was overrun, every pack got out. Spoke's scouts had found the gaps; Stride had already driven through them.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: I trust you now. Don't make it weird.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: We'd never. Weird is a door. We just leave through it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Tzar and the Halberd park side by side. The ground complains.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Yeah. I'll take that wall.

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: Halberd's hungry. Which wall.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Any. Pick one. I'm easy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They take turns on the walls now. Bro arrives, the Halberd eats what's left.

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: You leave a lot.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: I'm not angry. I'm available. You're hungry. Works out.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Something big came at the pad. Something bigger met it, and then something hungrier.

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: Full.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Good. Nap?

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: Nap.

talks.title: Why
talks.motif: the shrug that insults the walk

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Brakhov burned his name off for this war. Bro is here because someone asked nicely.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: Name gone. Forward heat. Why are you here?

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Someone pointed at a wall.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: That is not a reason.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: It's worked so far.

talks.title: Arriving
talks.motif: the shrug that insults the walk

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They reached the same turret line. Brakhov walked into the fire. Bro drove around it and took it from behind.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: You did not face them.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: They're still dead, man.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: It matters how.

talks.title: Reasons
talks.motif: the shrug that insults the walk

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Brakhov asked Bro, at the fire, whether he had ever had a name worth burning.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Had one. Didn't need to burn it. Nobody ever asked for it.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: ...That might be worse.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Nah. It's lighter. You could try it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Solarium plants solar panels in rows. The Infestor plants itself in the gaps between them.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: Those aren't on the plan.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: Company grows itself.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: ...They are very tidy rows, at least.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The hive grew twice as fast beside the solar field. Solarium noticed, and added a row.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: Warm ground.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: I can budget for warm ground.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The garden held: panels, converters and a ring of legs that would not let anything near them.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: You're the best fence I've ever planted.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: You are the best soil.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Ketha brings back the dead by name. The Infestor makes new bodies that never had one.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Wrecks are unfinished sentences. Yours never start.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: Company grows itself.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Growing isn't the same as remembering.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Ketha has started naming the Infestor's spawn. There are a lot of them.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: They do not need names.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Everyone does. Even if they only live a minute. That one's called Brant.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: One of the hive's bugs came home dragging a hero's wreck back to Ketha's rez-bot.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Brant brought him back.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: It remembered what you told it.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Then it's a sentence after all.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Stride drove through the pad four times today. Hearth has not moved in a month.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: Doesn't it bore you? Sitting?

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.line: Quiet sun. Won't go out.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: That's not an answer.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.line: It's the only answer. Somebody has to be where you come back to.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Stride drove home through enemy fire because the lights at the pad were still on.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: I could see you from across the map.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.line: That's what I'm for.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Stride parked next to the reactor and turned the engines off. Nobody had ever seen them do that.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.line: You're staying?

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: For a minute. Don't tell anyone. We have a reputation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Rusk holds the gate. Warder holds the circle. They sit back to back, not talking.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: Gate, jammed gat, a lie.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Owns a circle of dirt.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: Good dirt?

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Mine.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: What was the lie? At the gate.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: Told them reinforcements were coming. Held six hours on it.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Did they come?

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: No. But I'd have held either way. The lie was for them, not me.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Rusk's gate was failing. Warder's beamers rolled up behind it. Warder had left the circle.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: You moved.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: The lie should come true once.

talks.title: Quiet
talks.motif: two quiet killers in the fog

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Two people who never raise their voices have found each other, and the camp is uneasy about it.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Ghosts already walked it.

beats.speaker: vale
beats.line: The wall never saw the invoice.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: We're the same thing at different distances.

talks.title: Leaving
talks.motif: two quiet killers in the fog

beats.speaker: vale
beats.line: You leave before they know you were there.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: So do you. You just leave a bill.

beats.speaker: vale
beats.line: Someone has to pay for the quiet.

talks.title: Nothing heard
talks.motif: two quiet killers in the fog

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: An entire enemy front lost its commanders and its walls on the same night. Nobody heard a thing.

beats.speaker: vale
beats.line: Your ghosts and my invoices.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: The best kind of night.

talks.title: Volume
talks.motif: two captains, one who never shouts

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Quill gives orders like artillery. Pavise gives them like weather reports.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: Orders walk on treads. They don't ask twice.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: They shouldn't need to. If you have to shout, you've already lost them.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: I've never lost a line.

talks.title: Listening
talks.motif: two captains, one who never shouts

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Quill tried giving a quiet order. The Bulls followed it faster.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: They listened harder.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: People lean in to hear you when you're quiet. They lean back when you shout.

talks.title: Succession
talks.motif: two captains, one who never shouts

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Pavise was down. Quill held the line without raising his voice once.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: I heard you on the radio. You sounded like me.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: I had a good teacher. Don't you dare die before I'm better at it.

talks.title: Sacred ground
talks.motif: the saint's garden and the welder's surprises

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Twitcher welded a booby trap into Sister Lumen's geothermal vent. She found it during prayers.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: Tithe the grid. Not the grid's plumbing.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: It was a gift.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: It hissed.

talks.title: Confession
talks.motif: the saint's garden and the welder's surprises

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: Is there a saint of mischief?

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: No.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: There should be. I'd apply.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: You'd have to stop booby-trapping the altar.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: ...I'll think about it.

talks.title: Blessed traps
talks.motif: the saint's garden and the welder's surprises

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Raiders came for Lumen's Pulsar. Twitcher's traps were all around it. She had let him plant them.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: Holy ground needs a fence.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: Did you just bless my mines?

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: Once. Don't make me regret it.

talks.title: Your Majesty
talks.motif: the spare king and the man who'll follow anyone

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Bro saluted Mask. Mask was so surprised he saluted back.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: Every throne needs a spare.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Sure, boss. Which wall?

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: You... believe I'm the commander?

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Do you? Then yeah.

talks.title: Royal escort
talks.motif: the spare king and the man who'll follow anyone

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Tzar has started following Mask around the battlefield, flattening anything that threatens the Pawns.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: You don't have to protect me. I'm a decoy.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Decoys need protecting most. Everybody's aiming at you.

talks.title: Crowned
talks.motif: the spare king and the man who'll follow anyone

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Sixteen Pawns, a Tzar and a decoy commander walked into the enemy's camp like a parade.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: They surrendered to me. Me.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Told you. Belief's available. You just had to ask.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Odessa's Telchines came up the ford and found six Cutlasses floating in it.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: Fords are doors. You're parked in my doorway.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Lands where nobody parks. Somebody does now.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: Move.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: You could cross under us. We float.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: I don't cross under things. I own the hinge.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Then we'll own the sky over your hinge. Deal?

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: ...Deal. Stay out of the middle.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The water rose over the ford. Odessa held it from below; Gale held it from above. The enemy never found a way across.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: My door. Your sky.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Our river.
